in_arabic.name: أزارنگ

in_urdu.name: اعزازنگ

in_pashto.name: اعزازنگ
in_pashto.meaning: د عزت او لوړتیا لرونکی واکمن

data.cultural_impact: The name 'Azarang' holds a rich cultural significance for those of Persian and Islamic origin. As a Persian name, it draws from the long history of Iranian culture that places a great emphasis on the beauty of the natural world. The autumn season, represented by the name's meaning, is a time when nature transitions from the lush, green colors of summer to the vibrant oranges, yellows, and reds of autumn. This is a time of harvest and celebration, which is reflected in the naming traditions of Persian communities.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name 'Azarang' represents the idea of transformation and the cyclical nature of life. The autumn season, with its dying leaves and the onset of winter, can be seen as a reminder of the impermanence of all things and the importance of cherishing moments and the beauty of the present. The golden hue of the leaves and the sun represents the idea of inner light and spiritual growth, inspiring those with the name to strive towards personal enlightenment and fulfillment. Like the golden light of the setting sun, the name 'Azarang' serves as a reminder of the enduring beauty and light within us all.

Azarang was also the name of a Persian poet and scholar who lived during the Timurid Empire in the 14th century. He is known for his works on Persian literature and his contributions to the development of the Persian language.
